biggest_catch: You get paid only once your friend becomes a member and meets the eligibility requirements, and the full Program Rules live behind a separate link - check them before promising anyone a payout.
catches: Refer a friend or family member and earn $100 for each successful referral; up to 10 friends per calendar year ($1,000 annually).

The $100 is deposited as a bonus dividend into your savings account once your friend becomes a member and meets the eligibility requirements - per the official Program Rules that means opening a checking account with direct deposit (a payroll-cycle trigger, so expect weeks).
Your friend also earns a bonus when they open a checking account with direct deposit or get an auto loan.
Full terms live in the linked official Program Rules PDF; fetched 2026-09-23. It states no numeric payout window, so a days-scale classification is not defensible.
Terms and conditions apply; no stated fee to refer.
